records.jp: 来た途端にこんな手間をかけさせて、<CR>ごめんなさい
records.en_original: I'm sorry to make you do this right after we got here.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry to make you do this right after we got here.
records.en: I'm sorry to make you do this right after<CR>we got here.

records.jp: 全然だって！　そんなことより……
records.en_original: Don't worry about it!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about it!
records.en: Not at all! More importantly...

records.jp: びっくりしちゃったよー。<CR>保健室入った途端に、思いっきり転ぶんだもん
records.en_original: You surprised me. You fell down the moment you stepped into the nurse's office.
records.en_auxiliary: You surprised me. You fell down the moment you stepped into the nurse's office.
records.en: You surprised me.<CR>You fell down the moment you stepped into the nurse's office.

records.jp: 美弦さんも、何もないところで<CR>転んだりするんだねー
records.en_original: Do you often trip and fall out of nowhere, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you often trip and fall out of nowhere, Mio?
records.en: Even you trip over nothing sometimes,<CR>Mio-san.

records.jp: そのくらいするわよ。普通にそそっかしいもの
records.en_original: It happens. I can be a bit careless.
records.en_auxiliary: It happens. I can be a bit careless.
records.en: Of course I do. I'm normally rather careless.

records.jp: そそっかしい美弦さんなんて、あんまり目撃した<CR>ことないんですけどー
records.en_original: I've never seen you act careless before, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I've never seen you act careless before, though.
records.en: I've hardly ever seen you act careless before,<CR>Mio-san.

records.jp: 転んだのがたまたま保健室で、運がよかったよね
records.en_original: It was lucky that you were already in the nurse's office when you fell.
records.en_auxiliary: It was lucky that you were already in the nurse's office when you fell.
records.en: It was lucky that you were already in the nurse's office when you fell.

records.jp: おかげで、すぐにこうやって手当てもできたし。<CR>……とと。しみたりしてない？
records.en_original: Thanks to that I was able to take care of you right away. There, there... Does that sting?
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks to that I was able to take care of you right away. There, there... Does that sting?
records.en: Thanks to that, I was able to treat you right away.<CR>...There. Does it sting?

records.jp: 大丈夫よ。ありがとう。変な転び方をしたから、<CR>助かったわ
records.en_original: It's fine. Thanks. I fell in a strange way so it's lucky you were there.
records.en_auxiliary: It's fine. Thanks. I fell in a strange way so it's lucky you were there.
records.en: I'm fine. Thank you. I fell awkwardly,<CR>so you really helped me.

records.jp: うんうん。感謝したまえ
records.en_original: Yes, yes. You should be grateful.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, yes. You should be grateful.
records.en: Yes, yes. You should be grateful.

records.jp: 膝、結構派手に擦りむいちゃってるけど、<CR>なんであんな派手に転んだの？
records.en_original: You scraped your knee pretty badly. What made you take a fall like that?
records.en_auxiliary: You scraped your knee pretty badly. What made you take a fall like that?
records.en: You scraped your knee pretty badly.<CR>What made you take a fall like that?

records.jp: ふと考え事をした時、ちょうどそこの床に<CR>綻びがあったみたいで、躓いたの
records.en_original: I suddenly got wrapped up in my thoughts, and I must have tripped on the crack in the floor there.
records.en_auxiliary: I suddenly got wrapped up in my thoughts, and I must have tripped on the crack in the floor there.
records.en: I became lost in thought just as I reached<CR>a damaged spot in the floor and tripped.

records.jp: えっ。<CR>あとでその辺の床、調べて直さないと危ないね
records.en_original: Hmm. We'll have to fix the floor. It could be dangerous.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. We'll have to fix the floor. It could be dangerous.
records.en: What?<CR>We need to inspect and fix that part of the floor later, or it'll be dangerous.

records.jp: ええ。私の場合、注意していれば良かっただけ<CR>なんだけどね
records.en_original: Yes. I should have been paying attention, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I should have been paying attention, though.
records.en: Yes. I should have been paying attention,<CR>though.

records.jp: いやでも……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: 私もわりと、ボーッとしてて転んじゃうことって<CR>あるなぁ。あと、頭ぶつけたりとか？
records.en_original: I get distracted and fall down too sometimes. I've even hit my head a few times.
records.en_auxiliary: I get distracted and fall down too sometimes. I've even hit my head a few times.
records.en: I sometimes space out and fall too.<CR>Or hit my head, I guess?

records.jp: 愛央は、もう少し注意深くなって
records.en_original: You should be more careful, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You should be more careful, Ao.
records.en: You should be more careful, Ao.

records.jp: 転んだ人に言われたくなーい
records.en_original: You're one to talk!
records.en_auxiliary: You're one to talk!
records.en: You're one to talk!

records.jp: 私も気が付いてたら、美弦さんが転ぶ前に<CR>防げたんだよね。ごめん
records.en_original: If I'd been paying closer attention, I could have stopped you from falling. I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: If I'd been paying closer attention, I could have stopped you from falling. I'm sorry.
records.en: If I'd noticed, I could have stopped you before you fell,<CR>Mio-san. Sorry.

records.jp: どうして愛央が謝るの
records.en_original: Why are you apologizing, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you apologizing, Ao?
records.en: Why are you apologizing, Ao?

records.jp: 私、考え事に夢中になると、よくこういう事故<CR>起こすから、気を付けるようにしないと
records.en_original: I often cause accidents like this when I daydream. I should be more careful.
records.en_auxiliary: I often cause accidents like this when I daydream. I should be more careful.
records.en: When I become absorbed in thought, I often have accidents like this,<CR>so I need to be more careful.

records.jp: よく起こすんだ！？
records.en_original: This happens a lot?!
records.en_auxiliary: This happens a lot?!
records.en: This happens a lot?!

records.jp: でも……なんだか不思議な感じ
records.en_original: Still... This feels a little weird.
records.en_auxiliary: Still... This feels a little weird.
records.en: Still... This feels a little weird.

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: こんな風にクラスメイトに手当てしてもらうなんて、<CR>初めてのことかも
records.en_original: This might be the first time I've ever had a classmate take care of me like this.
records.en_auxiliary: This might be the first time I've ever had a classmate take care of me like this.
records.en: This might be the first time I've ever had a classmate take<CR>care of me like this.

records.jp: あ、愛央はもちろん年下で、クラスメイトじゃ<CR>ないんだけど……
records.en_original: Oh, I suppose you're younger so you're not technically my classmate, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I suppose you're younger so you're not technically my classmate, but...
records.en: Oh, of course you're younger and not actually<CR>my classmate, but...

records.jp: うーん。美弦さんとクラスメイトかぁ。<CR>そういうの、いいなぁ
records.en_original: Mm... I wish I could've been your classmate.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... I wish I could've been your classmate.
records.en: Hmm. Being classmates with you, Mio-san...<CR>That sounds nice.

records.jp: 私、無愛想だったと思うんだけど……
records.en_original: I don't think I was very friendly, though...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I was very friendly, though...
records.en: I don't think I was very friendly, though...

records.jp: どっちかっていうと、私の方が取り柄なさすぎて<CR>覚えてもらえなそう……
records.en_original: If anything, I was so unremarkable that you wouldn't remember me...
records.en_auxiliary: If anything, I was so unremarkable that you wouldn't remember me...
records.en: If anything,<CR>I was so unremarkable that you wouldn't remember me...

records.jp: それじゃ、お互いにいま出会えて良かったのかしら
records.en_original: Then it's a good thing we met each other here!
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's a good thing we met each other here!
records.en: Then perhaps it's a good thing we met each other now.

records.jp: ……うん。そうかも！
records.en_original: Yeah... That's true!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... That's true!
records.en: Yeah... That's true!

records.jp: クラスメイトだよ！　とりあえずこの世界ではね
records.en_original: You are my classmate! In this world, at least.
records.en_auxiliary: You are my classmate! In this world, at least.
records.en: We're classmates! At least in this world.

records.jp: ……愛央のそういう考え方、とても好き。<CR>そうね、そう考えていいんだわ
records.en_original: You're right. I really like the way you think, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. I really like the way you think, Ao.
records.en: I really like that way you think, Ao. Yes...<CR>It's all right for me to think of it that way.

records.jp: えへへ。ありがと！
records.en_original: Ehehe, thanks!
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe, thanks!
records.en: Ehehe, thanks!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
